Select compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Start from molecule_dictionary for CHEMBL1422 as parent. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to include the parent row and all child salts. Join compound_records on molregno, then activities on record_id, then docs on doc_id for pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Join assays on assay_id for assay_description. Join target_dictionary on tid for target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Filter to standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and target chembl_id CHEMBL284. Sort by all output columns. No row limit.
